source.title: Wegovy (semaglutide): a new weight loss drug for chronic weight management

consistency_findings.finding: The column labeled "Discontinuation due to GI AE (%)" contains 31%, 39%, 54%, and 40% for PIONEER 10. These values conflict with the review narrative, which states GI-event discontinuation ranged from 4.9%-12% in PIONEER. The values were not silently corrected and are not atomized as discontinuation rates.

The narrative states 86.5% achieved at least 5% weight loss, while Table 5 reports 86.4%. The table value is preserved in table-derived atoms and the difference is treated as a minor source discrepancy.

The retrieved article is a narrative literature review, not a primary study. Trial-level atoms are therefore tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to the review. They must not be treated as primary-study extractions.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is designed for primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review or secondary-reported-result atom kind. Secondary study results are represented with standard atom kinds plus secondary_reported_result tags, with provenance anchored to the review.

QuantitativeResult requires one primary estimate even when a review table reports several treatment-arm values. The selected semaglutide arm is stored as estimate and all reported arms are preserved in arms.
The model has no field for systematic-review risk-of-bias methods. This source also did not report a formal risk-of-bias assessment.
extraction_limitations: No primary-study publication was substituted for the review during ATOM extraction.
Source table inconsistencies were preserved or flagged rather than corrected from external knowledge.
The review search methods are not systematic enough to establish complete evidence capture.
protocol_conflicts_or_version_issues: The governing file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md but its internal H1 identifies the integrated compact protocol as v3. Per project precedence, the named v4 file governed this run and the separate v3 HTML was historical reference only.
